name: Missing Authorization (advisory)
absence_requirements: AuthZ cannot be proven present from one hunk — confirm this route checks authorization server-side, keyed on the session subject, not a client-supplied id (CWE-862/863).
If it reads or mutates another user's object by id, confirm ownership is enforced before the operation (CWE-639 IDOR).
If it is a state-changing endpoint, confirm CSRF protection is present (CWE-352).
attack_scenario: an authenticated user changes an id in the request to act on another user's resource because the server trusts the client-supplied identifier
negative_test_hint: as user A, request user B's object id and assert the response is 403/404, not B's data

exemplar.noncompliant: order = Order.objects.get(id=request.GET["id"])   # any user can read any order
exemplar.compliant: order = Order.objects.get(id=request.GET["id"], owner=request.user)   # scoped to the caller
exemplar.explanation: scope every object lookup to the authenticated subject; never trust a client-supplied id alone
